title: AdminZone
description: An add-on for the server with good functionality for convenient server administration.
body:
![A convenient utility for your server, suitable for vanilla and other modes. *photo-banner*](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b56ad7132cc0c6f768d02c463bcc765e3124c78.jpeg)The plugin provides functionality for creating an admin room and conducting conversations with players, or it can be used as a recreation area for server admins.

in 1.7 version

+anti-grief system

When a player is teleported, his game mode switches to adventure so that he cannot break anything, and when teleported back, his mode returns to either survival if he was in it.

List of commands:

/adm 1|2|3 (rooms) will teleport to the admin area

/adm <name> 1|2|3 teleport the player

/abring return to the location before teleporting

/abring <name> to return the player to the place before teleporting 

/setadm 1|2|3 set the admin zone [x\y\z yaw\pith]

/adm.info view information

/adm.gui Interface for easy use

==========================

Premissions:

psh.adm: Access to /adm

psh.setadm: Access to /setadm and /adm.reload
 
  psh.abring: Access to /abring

psh.info : Access to /adm.info

psh.gui : Access to /adm.gui
